directions.name: 大地图优先
directions.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a realistic, production-quality Chinese desktop roguelike dungeon exploration interface design, a visual candidate only. Target dimensions 1672 x 941, 16:9. Image 1 is the actual old game background and EDIT TARGET: preserve its upper 40 percent gothic moonlit castle environment and the horizontal 40/60 division. Redesign ONLY its lower 60 percent exploration control console. Image 2 is the game's actual crossed-sword node icon, use it as visual/style reference. Fixed style: existing cold-steel dark fantasy game UI, charcoal gunmetal, brushed dark iron, restrained worn silver edges and silver-cyan highlights, clear Chinese sans-serif type, no parchment, wax seals, gold ornament, sci-fi neon, web-browser/device frame, or gratuitous dashboard widgets. Preserve upper image atmosphere; no invented upper HUD. In the lower area leave the far left approx 235px and far right approx 90px as quiet safety margins for existing party/side HUD, not extra columns of new controls. The actual interactive console spans the central area between these safe margins. Illustrative scenario: exploration progress '探索进度 12 / 45', current room cleared, four distinct reachable destinations (combat, event, elite, treasure). Only use existing game actions: select a reachable node, inspect risk/reward, view route overview, return to current position. No new inventory, resource currencies, purchases, difficulty selector, classes, or gameplay features. The screenshot must look intentional and readable, with one primary task: choosing the next destination. Use spacing and alignment first, quiet dividers second, borders sparingly. All text must fit, avoid microtext and excessive copy. No option numbers, concept title labels, watermark or explanatory captions outside UI. Do not combine multiple designs into one image.
Direction: MAP-FIRST NAVIGATION CONSOLE. A broad continuous dark steel route canvas uses most of the lower central area, with 5 clearly spaced progress columns and roughly 14 icon nodes. Build 4 tidy, visibly separated branching paths with only a few intentional merge points, no spaghetti crossings, no road-following realism. Left-to-right reading, current node with a silver cyan ring, reachable nodes clear and softly lit, future nodes subdued; small return branch visible. Header is a lightweight horizontal line reading '探索路线' with '探索进度 12 / 45'. Selected or hovered node shows one small attached contextual tooltip containing '普通遭遇' and '查看详情', not a permanent sidebar. Bottom toolbar is a thin continuous rail with compact section indices and buttons '全部连线' '路线总览' '当前位置'. Route canvas has subtle grain and almost invisible grid, not a dense grid. Prioritize spacious map over cards, very restrained material framing. No big primary button apart from node interaction.

Direction: MAP WITH NODE DOSSIER. Lower central console is asymmetric: the left roughly 70 percent contains a spacious tidy branching node map with 4 progress columns and around 10 nodes; the right roughly 30 percent is a single integrated unboxed steel dossier strip, separated by one thin vertical rule. The map has 4 clear choices near the current node. Highlight the elite destination and its full path. Dossier contains a larger crossed-sword crest, heading '精英遭遇', short rows '风险 较高' and '收益 较高', concise line '准备充分后再前往', and ONE clear silver-cyan primary button '进入节点'. The dossier is part of the continuous console surface, not stacked cards. A quiet top line says '探索路线' and '探索进度 12 / 45'; bottom left minimal section navigation, buttons '路线总览' '当前位置'. Keep total lower composition well spaced, no more than two meaningful content regions, subtle solid panel tones; map and dossier must feel visually balanced and distinctly different from a map-filling-the-entire-console design.

Direction: NEXT-DESTINATION DECISION CONSOLE. Lower central console emphasizes the immediate decision instead of displaying a dense entire graph. A compact current-position module on the left occupies about 24 percent, with a glowing cleared-room node, label '当前位置', and state '已清剿'. To its right four generous destination rows share ONE continuous grouped surface, each row has a meaningful steel icon, large destination name, short risk label, a slim directional path indicator, and a subtle select affordance. Rows labeled '普通遭遇', '未知事件', '精英遭遇', '宝箱岔路', with risk words '常规' '未知' '较高' '支路'. Connect the current node to the four rows using ordered fan-out lines with a common vertical spine and clean separated horizontal exits, no tangles. Highlight one row in pale silver-cyan. The four rows are not four bulky floating cards; use crisp separators, strong alignment and enough breathing room. Top of console a slim progress trail and '探索进度 12 / 45'; bottom slim navigation with '路线总览' and '当前位置'. Preserve possibility of backtracking in a small secondary '返回已探索节点' affordance tied to the existing route, not a new gameplay mechanic. This should feel like a focused tactical selection instrument, not a SaaS table. Keep the full upper background unchanged.
